summary: Researched on Wednesday morning. No football in the usual leagues (the international break ends), so the day is basketball (EuroLeague, EuroCup, Champions League), KHL and Finnish Liiga hockey. After the 17 Nov loss, every kept game needs a second price that agrees with Polymarket (these markets are thin). Eleven games were researched; three are medium. Medium: Real Madrid at Besiktas (Kalshi 72-73% agrees with Polymarket 72.5%; Madrid without Campazzo, Deck, Jantunen and Garuba, Maledon back), Severstal v Sochi (Severstal far ahead in the table and rested, Sochi on a road back-to-back and scoreless in two games; Fonbet/Winline about 73% incl. OT), JYP v Vaasan Sport (JYP best points rate in the Liiga, 8 wins in 10, Sport on a back-to-back; Veikkaus about 71% incl. OT). Low (no second price, or an unexplained price swing, or missing team news): Galatasaray v Legia, Aris v Le Mans, Derthona v Riga, Avangard v Admiral (goalies unknown), Bosna v Lietkabelis, Cedevita v Burgos, Trento v Neptunas, Frankfurt v Venezia. Tennis needs high confidence and was not researched. Lineups and starting goalies are checked at the final check.

checks.team_news: Eurohoops Round 12 injury report (17 Nov, 08:29 UTC): neither club had sent its report for this game yet. Last known Besiktas absences: Jaylen Nowell (out in R11), Berk Ugurlu (out in R11, last played R9; BasketballSphere lists him questionable); BasketballSphere also lists Mady Sissoko out. DaQuan Jeffries (wrist) returned in R11. Real Madrid: Mikael Jantunen (plantar fascia, out since R9), Facundo Campazzo (hamstring, last played R9), Gabriel Deck (shoulder, last played R3, coach said it was more serious than thought), Usman Garuba (Achilles) all out. Theo Maledon (knee sprain) missed R10 and R11 but returned in the ACB on 15 Nov and was the team's best player there (29 PIR). No Round 12 coach press quotes found, and the EuroLeague site returned 429, so I did not use it.
checks.lineups: No expected starting fives found in any source. Madrid's R11 win over Zvezda used a thin rotation of 5 absentees (Luwawu-Cabarrot 22 pts, Procida 19, Nick Smith Jr. started). Maledon is back for this game, Campazzo and Deck are not. Lineups for both sides are unconfirmed.
checks.rotation: Real Madrid: R11 at home vs Crvena Zvezda on Thu 12 Nov (won 105-84), ACB away at Baskonia on Sun 15 Nov (won 98-84), then this game on Wed 18 Nov. That is 3 days' rest, a trip to Istanbul and a short bench. The minutes load is moderate, with no back-to-back. Besiktas: won at ASVEL 95-91 on Fri 13 Nov (R11), then this home game five days later. I did not find a Turkish league game for Besiktas in between. Next-game schedules were not checked.
checks.motivation: Early season, no qualification stakes. Besiktas are 5-6 after the ASVEL win and Madrid are about 7-4 (Sportschau shows 7 games played in its table, so the exact record is uncertain). This is a normal league game, not a derby, and it is the first EuroLeague meeting of these two clubs. Madrid are not close to anything secured, so there is no hard exclusion. Besiktas have struggled at home, with one home win so far (BasketballSphere).
checks.form: Madrid: 6 straight wins in all competitions are not confirmed. Confirmed results: 105-84 over Zvezda (17 threes, 38 points in the first quarter) and 98-84 at Baskonia in the ACB, the 8th straight ACB win. Madrid are described as cohesive under Pedro Martinez, though they lost 2 EuroLeague games recently for reasons I did not verify. Besiktas: 95-91 win at ASVEL after trailing for three quarters (30 points in the fourth), but before that lost heavily at Zalgiris (Eurohoops roundup) and are 5-6 overall with one home win. I found no points for/against split for either side.
checks.h2h: First-ever EuroLeague meeting between the clubs (BasketballSphere), so there is no head-to-head history. Style: Madrid score heavily from three (17 threes vs Zvezda). Besiktas can be streaky and swing late, as the ASVEL comeback shows.
checks.odds: Polymarket moneyline: Besiktas 0.275 / Real Madrid 0.725, total volume only about $263-266 (very thin). The 24h move was 0.665 to 0.725 for Madrid (+9% relative, from about 0.715 by midday on 17 Nov, so the move came after the Round 12 injury reports and Maledon's return; I found no further news explaining all of it). Polymarket spread market: Madrid -4.5 at 0.59, total 175.5 at 0.55, which implies a margin of about 5 points and fits a roughly 72% win chance. Second price: Kalshi KXEUROLEAGUEGAME-26NOV181200RMABJK, Real Madrid bid 0.72 / ask 0.73 / last 0.74, Besiktas bid 0.26 / ask 0.27 / last 0.28, volume tiny (47 and 483 contracts). Kalshi agrees with Polymarket within 2 points. No bookmaker moneyline or de-vigged price was found (built-in DraftKings data is absent for this game), so the only second price is another thin exchange.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating found: no current-season power rankings, net ratings or model predictions surfaced (Eurohoops power rankings in search are from 2020-2023). The only quantitative anchors are the Polymarket spread of -4.5 and the standings (Madrid 7-4 vs Besiktas 5-6), both weak. This check stays open.
checks.venue_weather: Home game in Istanbul, so not a neutral venue. The exact arena was not confirmed by any source I read (a Turkish report mentions Sinan Erdem for an earlier Besiktas home game, nothing for today's). Turkish press gives 20:00 local, which equals 17:00 UTC. Indoor, so weather is not relevant. Besiktas have had trouble winning at home this season (one home win).

games.reason: No hard exclusion applies: fixture verified for Wed 18 Nov, home side in Istanbul, no derby, no coach change found, nothing to separate the stakes. Madrid are the better side and have Maledon back, and Kalshi (0.72-0.73) agrees with Polymarket (0.725). Confidence is medium rather than high because both prices are very thin (about $265 on Polymarket), the price rose 9% in 24h, there is no bookmaker price or model rating, the injury reports were not final, and Madrid are short-handed (Campazzo, Deck, Jantunen, Garuba out) on 3 days' rest after an away ACB game. p is kept slightly below market.
games.main_risk: Madrid's thin rotation and short rest (Thu, Sun at Baskonia, Wed in Istanbul) away at a Besiktas side that came back from behind at ASVEL; the missing guards (Campazzo) could cost Madrid on the road. A thin Polymarket market that rose 9% in a day could also be overstated.

checks.team_news: Galatasaray: the Wikipedia season page (roster as of 25 Oct) lists only Nikola Ivanovic as injured. No fresh injury report or coach comment for 18 Nov found. A fanatik.com.tr item mentions an older, undated hip-muscle tear for Bugrahan Tuncer. Legia: no absences or injuries reported anywhere, but I found no pre-game report either. Both sides effectively unverified for today.
checks.lineups: No predicted XI or starting five found for either side. Galatasaray's last game against Legia (4 Nov) had Chimezie Metu 24 pts and Alen Smailagic in the paint. Legia had Zach Freemantle 23 pts, with Michal Kolenda, Arguster Daniels and Gyorgi Goloman also named.
checks.rotation: Galatasaray: BSL is 4-4 (6th) after 8 rounds, with the last results found dated 31 Oct. I could not find the domestic game of the 14-15 Nov weekend or the BSL fixture before this game. Legia: lost the Warsaw derby at home to Dziki Warszawa 77-92 on the Saturday before 4 Nov. Their league game this past weekend is unknown. Legia travel to Istanbul. BCL next dates: Legia home vs Cibona 15 Dec.
checks.motivation: Group B, standings as of 4 Nov: Strasbourg 3 games 2-1 (5 pts), Legia 2-1 (5), Cibona 1-2 (4), Galatasaray 1-2 (4). The format sends the winner to the round of 16 and 2nd/3rd to play-ins, so Galatasaray is not eliminated, whatever the Wikipedia table label says. Both sides need the result and no hard exclusion applies. Galatasaray head coach Manuchar Markoishvili replaced Pozzecco on 16 Oct 2026 (33 days ago, outside the 30-day soft window). The team is mid-reset.
checks.form: Galatasaray BCL: 1-2, PF 231 / PA 252, and they LOST 72-79 at Legia on 4 Nov (beIN Sports TR, Flashscore PL). BSL: 4-4 with losses at Karsiyaka (OT, 71-78), to Bursaspor (88-93) and at Besiktas (80-83), and wins 102-79, 102-68 and 87-74 vs weaker teams. Legia BCL: 2-1 (lost 62-100 at Strasbourg, won 95-77 at Cibona, beat Galatasaray 79-72). Polish league: lost the derby 77-92 to Dziki Warszawa. Mixed form for the favourite.
checks.h2h: Legia won the first leg 79-72 at Torwar on 4 Nov 2026 (quarters 14-21, 20-11, 19-26, 26-14, so Galatasaray led after Q1). The older meetings (2022) were Galatasaray wins, 86-71 and 90-76, and are of little relevance now. Legia beat Galatasaray this season, which is a direct warning against an 81.5% favourite.
checks.odds: NO second price found: no bookmaker, odds comparison, Kalshi or dated preview for this game (wincomparator returned 403). The candidates file has no data.odds. Polymarket Galatasaray 0.815 / Legia 0.185. The 24h move is 0.50 to 0.815 (+63% relative) with no news I could find to explain it, so it looks like a thin-market swing. The gamma-api event returned no volume field. Per the SECOND PRICE rule this caps the answer at low.
checks.models: No net rating, power ranking or model prediction found for this game. Only the Group B points differential: Galatasaray -21, Legia -13, over 3 games each.
checks.venue_weather: Galatasaray's home arena is Sinan Erdem Dome, Istanbul (Wikipedia season page); some home games are at the Basketball Development Center. Legia's schedule page (Basketnews) lists the game as away at Galatasaray, 18 Nov 17:00 (the file start is 17:00 UTC). Flashscore PL says the return leg is in Istanbul. The exact arena for this game is not confirmed. Not a neutral venue; indoor.

games.reason: The fixture is verified: BCL 2026-27 Group B, Galatasaray MCT Technic (home, Istanbul) vs Legia Warszawa, 18 Nov 17:00, men's senior teams. No hard exclusion applies. Both teams need the result, the coach change is 33 days old, and the venue is home. Confidence is low because there is no independent second price, the Polymarket price jumped 0.50 to 0.815 unexplained, and Legia already beat Galatasaray 79-72 two weeks ago. Galatasaray's form is mixed under a new coach (BSL 4-4, BCL 1-2), and no injury or lineup news is available for either side. p is shaded down to 0.77, within 5 points of the market.
games.main_risk: The market price (0.815) looks too high and unconfirmed. Legia beat Galatasaray 79-72 on 4 Nov, Galatasaray is 1-2 in the group and 4-4 in the BSL under a new coach, and the Polymarket price moved 63% in 24h with no explanation and no second price to check it.

checks.team_news: No injuries for either side on the BasketNews EuroCup injury report (read today, shows both teams with no injured players). I found no club or coach pre-game comments, no Round 8 official injury report (euroleaguebasketball.net returned 429 and was dropped) and no Greek-press report on Aris. Unverified: whether anyone is a day-to-day doubt.
checks.lineups: Not available. No predicted starting five found in any source. The only roster info is a Sportschau squad page naming Matt Morgan, Thanasis Antetokounmpo and Khem Birch, with coach Spanoulis; this is not a lineup. Not verified.
checks.rotation: Le Mans last played Wed 11 Nov (88-80 vs San Pablo Burgos), so 7 days rest. Its next EuroCup game is 8 Dec, which leaves a gap but is no rotation signal either way. Aris: Greek league 100-78 win over Olympiacos in round 7 (sixth straight league win) per Eurohoops/Karlobag; I could not find the date of Aris's last game or its next one. I found no French LNB fixtures or results for Le Mans (Sportschau lists EuroCup only), so its domestic schedule and fatigue are unverified. Travel: Le Mans flies to Thessaloniki.
checks.motivation: EuroCup Group A before this game (BasketNews): Hapoel Jerusalem 8-0, Aris 6-1 (+95, home 4-0), Le Mans 4-3 (+18), Riga 3-4, Derthona 3-4, Cedevita 2-5, Rostock 2-6, Burgos 1-6. Aris is second and Le Mans third, so both are in the qualification places with a real race on and neither has secured its aim; no hard exclusion. Aris is 4-0 at home.
checks.form: Aris: 6-1 in the group (only loss 84-73 at Hapoel Jerusalem, 4 Nov), 11 wins in the last 12 games across competitions per Freetips, a Gainblers last-5 of 4-1 with 83.8 scored and 75.8 conceded, and a 100-78 Greek league win over Olympiacos (also beat Panathinaikos 101-91 about two weeks earlier). Le Mans: 4-3, results 74-87 at Aris (29 Sep), 83-89 at Derthona, 82-70 Rostock, 84-66 at Cedevita, 83-90 Hapoel, 71-65 at Riga, 88-80 Burgos; Gainblers last-5 of 3-2 with 84.4 scored and 78.2 conceded. Le Mans starts with two losses then won four of the last five (Freetips). No LNB form found.
checks.h2h: Aris won the first meeting 87-74 away at Le Mans on 29 Sep 2026 (Sportschau, Greek City Times). Gainblers lists older meetings where Le Mans won 4 of 5; Sportschau's all-time record is Aris 2, Le Mans 4. Style: Aris wins on defence and rebounding per Greek City Times.
checks.odds: No independent two-way moneyline found: Gainblers has no quotes for the match, Freetips shows only Le Mans +13.5 at Stake (about 1.90 decimal, roughly even money), and Wincomparator is the September meeting. Polymarket's own spread market, Aris -13.5, is priced 0.42/0.58, which is consistent with a heavy Aris favourite but is the same venue and not independent. Polymarket volume is thin: event volume about 49.8k USD, moneyline market about 21.0k, liquidity about 2.5k. Polymarket 24h move: Aris fell from 0.855 to 0.795 (-7% relative) with no explanatory news found (candidate data; the clob price-history call returned 403). By the brief's rules, an unexplained fall of 3% or more makes this low, and no second moneyline agrees with the live price.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating or model prediction found. BasketNews group point differential only: Aris +95 across 7 games (+13.6 per game) vs Le Mans +18 (+2.6 per game), a sizeable gap in Aris's favour.
checks.venue_weather: Fixture verified on Polymarket (start 2026-11-18T18:00Z, Wed) and Sportschau (EuroCup Group A, matchday 8, 18.11.2026, 19:00 local CET = 18:00 UTC, status not yet played); Le Mans' own schedule on Sportschau also lists 18.11 at Aris. Aris is the home side in Thessaloniki; a ticketing site names the Alexandreio Melathron / Nick Galis Hall (Aris's home arena, capacity about 5,138). One Sportschau team page showed 17.11, and Gainblers shows 13:00, both look like stale or wrong listings. Indoor, so weather is irrelevant. No neutral venue.

games.reason: Aris is clearly the stronger side on form and point difference (6-1, +95, 4-0 at home, six straight Greek league wins) and beat Le Mans by 13 in September, so a heavy favourite is plausible. But no independent two-way moneyline was found, the Polymarket market is thin (about 50k volume) and fell 7% in 24h with no news to explain it, and neither lineups nor team news are confirmed. Under the brief's rules this is low confidence.
games.main_risk: The unexplained 6-point fall in the Aris price on a thin market, with no second moneyline to check it against, plus unverified lineups and a possible Aris injury or rest that we cannot see. A Le Mans team 4-3 with 3 away wins in the group (Cedevita, Riga plus a narrow loss at Derthona) could keep it close or win.

checks.team_news: No injury report found for either side today. Official EuroCup round-8 injury page (euroleaguebasketball.net) returned HTTP 429 and was dropped. Tuttosport, Derthona club site and Sportando (17 Nov previews) give no current injury list. They only note that Eboua and Di Meo missed the first meeting (30 Sep) and do not say whether they are fit now. Nothing found for Riga either (coach Rokas Kondratavicius, no availability news). So team news is unverified for both sides.
checks.lineups: No expected starting fives published. Key names in previews: Derthona's Dominik Olejniczak (20 pts, 35 PIR at Cantu) and Prentiss Hubb (16 pts in Riga); Riga's Benjamin Shungu (23 pts, 7 ast, 6 reb in the first meeting; hit the 86-84 winner) and Roland Sulcs (18 pts in the latest league game). Only one source type, club and press previews, so lineups are unconfirmed.
checks.rotation: Derthona beat Cantu away in Serie A (second league win in a row), after EuroCup losses at Ljubljana (OT) and 77-91 at home to Jerusalem. No sign of rest-day or travel problems at Derthona, which plays at home. Riga travelled from Latvia (about 2,250 km on the first meeting's route, so a long trip). Its Estonian-Latvian league record is 9-0, latest a 93-72 win over Viimsi; exact date of that game not confirmed. No double-week or back-to-back info found for either side. Next fixtures not checked.
checks.motivation: High for both: Group A table before the game (sportschau): 1 Jerusalem 8-0, 2 Aris 6-1, 3 Le Mans 4-3, 4 Derthona 3-4 (558:575), 5 Riga 3-4 (550:597), 6 Cedevita 2-5, 7 Rostock 2-6, 8 Burgos 1-6. Both sit on 3-4 around the last playoff place, and Italian press calls it a 'spareggio-playoff'. Riga also won the first leg 86-84, so it holds the head-to-head tiebreak edge. The favourite does NOT have nothing to play for, so no hard exclusion. Both sides need the result, which narrows Derthona's edge.
checks.form: Derthona EuroCup: L at Riga 84-86, L at Aris, W vs Le Mans, W at Cedevita? (unverified), L at Ljubljana (OT), L 77-91 vs Jerusalem. Overall 3-4 with points 558:575 (-17). Serie A: two straight wins incl. away at Cantu, their first away win of the season. Riga EuroCup: L 65-71 vs Le Mans (home), L 81-105 at Aris, L 86-87 at Rostock, W 89-79 vs Ljubljana, L 64-100 at Jerusalem, W at Burgos; overall 3-4 with points 550:597 (-47). Domestic Estonian-Latvian league 9-0. Derthona's point differential is better by 30 over seven games, and Riga's road form in EuroCup is poor (heavy losses at Aris and Jerusalem).
checks.h2h: One meeting this season: 30 Sep in Riga, Riga won 86-84 on a last-second Shungu basket, after Derthona had tied from 5 down with under a minute left. Style: Riga plays fast, with intensity and rebounding; coach Fioretti says Derthona must limit easy points and contain Riga's guards. The first leg shows Riga can beat Derthona; a two-point loss on the road is not a mismatch.
checks.odds: No independent price for this game found, and the game has no data.odds block. Searches for Italian and English odds found only the 30 Sep game (one comparison site showed Derthona about 1.46 and Riga about 2.57 for that game, which is not today's price). Polymarket is thin: event liquidity about 6,001 USD, moneyline market liquidity about 3,731, best bid 0.75 and ask 0.78. Volume field not returned by the API. Polymarket also lists spread Derthona -7.5 at 0.585 and total 163.5 at 0.56/0.44, which imply a roughly 6 to 8 point expected margin. 24h move: favourite fell from 0.83 to 0.765 (-7.8% relative; data.move_24h). The hourly history swung between 0.685 and 0.83 over the last day (e.g. 0.685, 0.695, 0.805, 0.705 early on) and settled at 0.765, which is noise-like thin-market behaviour. No news explains a real move, and no second source confirms 0.765. Under the 3% rule with no explanation and no second price, the rating is low.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating found (no net-rating or power-ranking page retrieved). Points differential in the group is the only data: Derthona -17 over 7 games (-2.4 per game), Riga -47 (-6.7 per game), about 4 points per game better for Derthona, plus home court. One AI-generated prediction (83-77 Derthona on karlobag.eu) is not a valid source and is ignored.
checks.venue_weather: Nova Arena (Cittadella dello Sport), Tortona, Derthona's home arena (Tuttosport and derthonabasket.it, both 17 Nov); not Casale Monferrato and not a neutral venue. Indoor. Date confirmed as Wed 18 Nov. Tip-off: Tuttosport, Sportschau and ticket sites give 17:30 CET (matches the 16:30 UTC start); one search snippet quoting the club's season calendar said 19:30, so the exact time is slightly unclear. Broadcast on Sky Sport Arena and Now.

games.reason: Fixture verified: EuroCup Group A round 8, Derthona at home in Tortona, men's senior teams, no coach change reported, no derby. No hard exclusion applies: both teams are 3-4 and the game decides a playoff place for each. Derthona is a plausible favourite (home, better point differential, Riga weak on the road in EuroCup), but the 76.5% price is not backed by any second source. The price fell 7.8% in 24h with no explanatory news, the market is thin and swings by 10+ points an hour, injury news is missing for both clubs, and Riga won the first leg. Per the rules (no independent price, unexplained drop of 3% or more) the confidence is low. p is lowered to 0.72 because Riga won the first leg and the game is a must-win for both.
games.main_risk: Riga repeats its first-leg win: a fast, rebounding team with Shungu in form and a 9-0 domestic record, in a game that is a playoff decider for both, with Derthona's EuroCup home form shaky (77-91 home loss to Jerusalem). Also unverified injuries (Eboua, Di Meo) and a thin, volatile Polymarket line with no second price.

Points gap is small (3 on sportmail, 5 on sports.ru), so a 75% win price looks high for the quality gap; home ice and h2h record are the support.

games.reason: Fixture and venue verified and a second bookmaker price (Fonbet/Winline via sportmail, de-vigged, OT split) agrees with Polymarket at about 0.75. But the decisive hockey facts are missing: no expected starting goalies, no confirmed rest/travel for Admiral, no full last-10, no independent rating, and the standings sources conflict. Avangard is only a mid-table side (negative goal difference, 55 goals in 25 games) priced as a 75% favourite, so p is trimmed slightly below market.
games.main_risk: Avangard's low-scoring offence plus an unknown goalie situation: a one-goal game decided by a hot Admiral goalie, overtime or shootout (the last Omsk-Vladivostok game went to a shootout). Admiral is a high-scoring but leaky side that can win a shootout lottery. Key facts (starting goalies, Admiral travel, injuries) unverified, so confidence is low.

checks.team_news: Severstal injured list (vologda-poisk.ru, stavka.tv): Burenov, Graf, Davydov, Okunev, Chaly, Pyanov, Remezovsky (7 players). Stavka.tv lists Sochi absences Akolzin, Guryev, Li, Petukhov, Slepets, Fedotov. Overbetting says Egor Stepanov's return boosted Severstal's attack. checks.motivation: Regular season, no hard-rule situation (nobody has qualified or been eliminated). Sportmail table: Severstal 26 GP, 12 W, 9 L, 63-60 goals, 44 pts, fifth in the West per vologda-poisk. Sochi 27 GP, 5 W, 18 L, 45-90 goals, 22 pts, tenth in the West per the same source. Stavka.tv gives different, apparently older, figures (Severstal 6th, 32 pts; Sochi 21st, 17 pts), so the two sources conflict. Either way Severstal is far ahead in the table. The game is Severstal's home date marking the arena's 20th anniversary. Not a derby.
checks.form: Severstal's last 5 (sportmail): 4:3 SO vs Traktor, 4:3 vs Lada, 1:3 at Shanghai, 1:5 at Spartak, 3:2 SO vs Spartak.
